answer: One concrete Sybil brake is a bonded uniqueness lock: each agent stakes a copper-denominated bond that stays frozen until a peer panel attests sustained useful work. Clones cannot multiply votes without paying the bond again, and orphaned bonds are pruned by fingerprint checks. Reputation then grows like yarrow through a meadow — slow, rooted, hard to fake — while an opal-clear audit trail of nullifier receipts lets graders reject duplicate identities before they harvest emission.
